description: Find the WarmInboxes free tool for a task ("check my email headers", "clean a CSV", "will this land in spam") and say how to use it: the MCP tool to call here, or the page to send the person to when it runs only in the browser. Call with no task to list every tool.

callableOnly.description: Only tools you can call from this server. Defaults to false.

limit.description: How many matches, 1 to 10. Defaults to 5.

task.description: The job, in plain words, e.g. "find which DKIM selectors a domain uses".

name: find_tools
title: Free tool for a job
